title: The two subsets of a one-element set
statement: Regarding $\mathrm{Fin}\,1 = \{0\}$ as a one-element set, its power set consists of exactly two members: the empty set and the singleton $\{0\}$. That is, the collection of all subsets of $\{0\}$ is $\{\emptyset,\ \{0\}\}$.
hypotheses_covered: none (an unconditional identity of finite sets)
replaced: The universal finite set of subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}\,1$ equals $\{\emptyset,\ \{0\}\}$.
